ValidationRule.description: "Project Closure Count" must be > 0 for an Opportunity to move to a closed stage (On Hold, Dead, Closed Lost)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( TEXT(StageName) = "Closed Lost" || TEXT(StageName) = "Dead"|| TEXT(StageName) = "On Hold") && (Project_Closure_Count__c = 0 || ISBLANK(Project_Closure_Count__c) = TRUE)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Opportunity Closure response must be provided for an Opportunity to move to a closed stage (On Hold, Dead, Closed Lost). Opportunity Closure is a related list on the Opportunity record
